At BlackScore, we build AI-native intelligence fusion platforms trusted by law enforcement . Our technology transforms massive volumes of raw data into actionable intelligence, helping analysts make faster,smarter decisions at national scale.

We are looking for curious, ambitious engineers who want to build impactful AI-powered systems from day one. You’ll contribute toproduction systems immediately, collaborate with experienced engineers, and gain exposure to cutting-edge AI technologies used in real-world environments. If you enjoy solving complex problems, learning quickly, and building products that matter, we’d love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

As part of our engineering team, you will:
Build real features used by real customers

Own projects end-to-end, from design to deployment

Design, develop, and deploy AI and machine learning models

Work across TypeScript, Go, Python, graph databases, AI APIs, and real-time analytics systems

Integrate AI solutions into production environments

Collaborate with software engineers, data scientists, and business teams to deliver AI-driven solutions

Maintain clear technical documentation for systems and architectures

Stay current with emerging AI/ML technologies and apply innovative approaches to improve our platforms

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking forbuilders, problem-solvers, and fast learners who are excited to work with modern AI technologies and solve real-world challenges.

Requirements

Graduating in 2025 , 2026 with a Degree in Computer Science or a related field

Strong coding and problem-solving abilities — language matters less than how you think

Built projects outside of coursework that you can showcase

Comfortable using AI tools as part of your daily development workflow

Strong written and verbal communication skills

Curious, self-driven, and able to learn independently without constant supervision

Ability to adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment

Experience with AI/ML frameworks or data-intensive applications

Exposure to cloud platforms, APIs, or real-time systems

Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Copilot, Claude, or ChatGPT

What We Offer

Competitive salary

Opportunities for rapid professional growth and mentorship

Exposure to cutting-edge AI technologies and large-scale intelligence systems

Access to modern engineering tools and infrastructure

The opportunity to work on meaningful technology with global impact

Our Hiring Process

We believe engineers should be evaluated based on how they actually work. As part of the interview process, candidates will complete a practical live problem-solving session using AI tools of their choice. We want to understand how you think, collaborate with AI, and build working solutions in real time.

Interested parties,please send your resume with current & expected salary & date availableto

jobs@example.com.

We regret only shortlisted applicantswill be notified.

BlackScore is a technology company seeking to disrupt risk assessment using AI-driven technology. Risk Scoring is at the heart of our philosophy, allowing companies make smart decisions based on vast amounts of data.
